[SWS_DM_01528] ara::diag::DoIPEntityIdentification not yet offered when DM needs to retrieve EID from Application
⌈
If the DM shall send the
EID while the Offer function of the ara::diag::DoIPEntityIdentification in-
terface was not called yet by the Adaptive Application that provides it, the DM shall
send a EID value equal to 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 or 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF
0xFF 0xFF ("value not set"), as defined in Table 5 and Table 1 in the ISO 13400-2:2012
specification.
⌋

specification.

[SWS_DM_01528] ara::diag::DoIPEntityIdentification not yet offered when DM needs to retrieve EID from Application
⌈

EID value equal ’0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF’.
